title: DRAM contract price Aug 2026: up, 3Q26 contract +13-18% QoQ, DDR4 spot +16.9% MoM in Jul (TrendForce)
note: TrendForce monthly contract-price print. Sources: TrendForce 2026-07-03 press (3Q26 conventional DRAM contract +13-18% QoQ, gains moderating), TrendForce 2026-08-04 press (DRAM supply tight through 2027), DDR4 1Gx8 3200 spot $37.14 -> $41.10 over July (record high).
